function: above_phy, p. 5: the learned FL-SNTD3 (TD3 DRL) agent chooses UAV flight decisions and the share of computing traffic offloaded from base stations to UAVs: "Action decisions include UAV flight decisions and the task size of handling traffic offloading."
notes: Title and DOI 10.1109/JIOT.2024.3363188 are on p. 1, so the PDF is the paper of the DOI. Reason above_phy, p. 5: the action is A = {FUAV(t), Dn(t)}, where "FUAV (t) includes the UAV's flight angle, horizontal flight rate and flight altitude, and Dn (t) indicates the proportion of traffic offloaded to UAVs offloading tasks", and the reward is the negative delay and energy cost of computation offloading (p. 5, Eq. 16). The learning therefore performs task offloading and UAV trajectory/placement decisions, both listed as above the physical layer; no transmit power, beam, or radio resource is learned, so the aerial-link exception does not apply. The federated learning is digital FedAvg at the leader UAV (p. 8, Eq. 36), not over-the-air computation, and the CPRAFT part is a consensus protocol for leader election (pp. 8-9).
